title: bug: verified-local task under deliveryPolicy legacy skips every required check
description: Repro: delivery/policy.ts evaluateDeliveryEvidence returns {satisfied:true} as soon as resolveTaskDeliveryPolicy gives 'legacy'. That happens before the CQ-V04 strong rule (trustedPassedOn, required-checks-undeclared) runs. So a verified-local task in a project with no deliveryPolicy, or with an explicit 'legacy', passes qa_approve and dependency readiness with no trusted check evidence at all. It is latent while assertExecutionProfileReady throws. Decide one fix: either require a strict deliveryPolicy whenever the profile is verified-local (settings validation or snapshot capture), or judge checks for verified-local even under legacy. Found in CQ-V04's adversarial review.
definitionOfDone: A verified-local task can never be judged satisfied without trusted required-check evidence, whatever deliveryPolicy is set
Legacy and observe verdicts unchanged; regression test covers verified-local + legacy/absent deliveryPolicy

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
A verified-local task is never judged delivered without trusted required-check evidence, whatever settings.deliveryPolicy says.
- evaluateDeliveryEvidence judges such a task's checks under the legacy policy (set, absent or null) with the CQ-V04 strong rules: trustedPassedOn per owed check, protected-check drift, and required-checks-undeclared.
- Legacy adds no landing evidence for any profile.
- Every task that is not verified-local is still satisfied at once under legacy.
- qa_approve and dependency readiness read that one predicate unchanged.
- deliveryProjection.requiredCheckSatisfied reports the same verdict for a verified-local legacy task, and stays absent for other legacy tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Verified-local with deliveryPolicy legacy, absent or null, and no trusted run: {policy:'legacy', satisfied:false, missingEvidence:['required-check:<each approved command>']}. There is no landing token even with no completion commit. When such a task is DONE it withholds its dependents (unmetDependsOn, dependencyShortfall).

An untrusted record_check_run report never counts. An authenticated passed run of each owed check in a listed environment satisfies the task. Removing the environment from checkEnvironments (including leaving it absent) brings the tokens back.

A stored verified-local snapshot stays judged after the live executionProfile and deliveryPolicy roll back to legacy. Owing nothing reports required-checks-undeclared. A malformed checkEnvironments throws INVALID_INPUT.

Legacy and observe tasks under legacy: {policy:'legacy', satisfied:true, missingEvidence:[]} with no run, even with a malformed checkEnvironments. The projection omits requiredCheckSatisfied. Every pre-existing test passes unchanged.
invariants: One predicate: qa_approve, dependency readiness and deliveryProjection all read evaluateDeliveryEvidence, with no parallel check.
assertExecutionProfileReady stays unconditional, so verified-local is unreachable in production. Only requiredChecks.strong.test.ts mocks it.
Under the legacy policy no task owes landing evidence.
An empty approved environment list is strict (trusted !== null), never read as non-strict.
compatibility: The DeliveryEvidenceResult and TaskDelivery shapes are unchanged; policy reports the live value ('legacy').
Legacy and observe verdicts, throws and projections are byte-identical. Settings validation and snapshot capture are unchanged. The captured deliveryPolicy stays identity only.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Chosen (b): judge a verified-local task's checks under every deliveryPolicy, inside evaluateDeliveryEvidence. qa_approve, dependency readiness and the projection all read that one predicate, so the DoD's 'whatever deliveryPolicy is set' holds by construction.

Rejected (a), requiring a strict deliveryPolicy whenever the profile is verified-local:
- resolveTaskDeliveryPolicy reads the LIVE deliveryPolicy, so a later rollback reopens the hole.
- So does a hand-edited project.json, which settings validation never sees.
- submit_plan keeps a stored verified-local snapshot whole, so capture cannot police later edits.

Also not done:
- Flooring verified-local's LANDING to local-branch: beyond the DoD; landing receipts are CQ-V07/V08.
- A result-shape change such as a 'checksJudged' field: it breaks the existing toEqual pins.
- A qa_approve-through-the-tool row: V06 adds a strict review-binding gate ahead of the evidence gate, so that row would break when V06 lands.

The projection change is included. Without it, the board (JetBrains DeliveryPresentation) would show a passed reported run with no verdict while qa_approve refuses, and this fix itself would create that disagreement.
